skills.skill: Multiply and divide fractions by fractions

misconceptions.pattern: Divides fractions by multiplying straight across instead of multiplying by the reciprocal (answers 1/2 ÷ 3/4 as 3/8 rather than 2/3).

strategies.intent: To multiply, multiply the numerators and the denominators. To divide, keep the first fraction, change ÷ to ×, and flip the second fraction (its reciprocal), then multiply.
